sequential_dependency.intermediate: The authored intermediate is the fully expanded grid. Same-color staircase bars that were separate diagonal singleton markers become one 4-connected component only in this grid.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the exact canonical scan: every cardinally isolated nonzero marker grows into a horizontal three-cell bar of its own color.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Find all same-color 4-connected nonzero components in the intermediate, select the largest by cell count with stable row-major tie behavior, and fill its bounding box with color 9.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The largest target component and its multi-row bounding box do not exist in the input. Skipping expansion leaves every staircase marker as a separate one-cell object, so the same largest-object/bounding-box operation changes only one cell and produces a different protected-Racket output.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical default plus a count-independent largest-expanded-component bounding-box variant; 2–6 demos, four queries including 30x30, protected Racket qualification evidence, adversarial shortcuts, and causal witness retained.

target_report.summary: Repaired strict override, capacity, and exact-marker-count behavior, then built an exact-canonical two-setting family. Expansion creates a largest staircase component whose bounding box is filled only in stage B; protected skip-A replay changes the final output.
